name: make-tape-collage
title_zh: 照片旁留一块暖白纸，胶带拼贴不遮原图
tagline_zh: 要胶带拼贴又舍不得原图？它把照片完整保留，另配暖白纸板用胶带做局部诠释。适合手账、装饰画，出图即贴纸质感。
tagline_en: Keep the photo intact, add a tape-built interpretation on warm-white paper. For journaling, decor, or hybrid.
desc_en: Transform a supplied photo or text description into a clean, tactile tape-collage raster artwork, or pair a faithfully preserved borderless photo print with a spacious warm-white paper panel containing a compact tape-built interpretation. Use for requests mentioning washi tape, masking-tape art, tape collage, 胶带拼贴, 和纸胶带拼贴, 胶带画, 拼贴手账, 保留原图, or photo-and-collage paper layouts.
why_zh: 不是把胶带糊在照片上，而是先分离画布：原图无损，拼贴独立成区。构图由程序算，不靠手抖。
why_en: It separates photo from collage instead of layering tape over the image. Layout is computed, edges stay clean—like real washi.
limit_zh: 只吃单张照片或文字描述，不做多图合成；输出是栅格图（PNG/JPG），不返回可编辑的矢量分层文件。
limit_en: Single photo or text input only; no multi-image compositing. Output is raster (PNG/JPG), not layered vector. Tape texture is washi-style only—no.
title_en: Tape collage beside the photo, not over it
